brief:
Israeli forces opened fire on civilians across multiple areas of Gaza, wounding a Palestinian woman and two children, Middle East Eye reported. The shooting incidents occurred in several locations, though specific details about the circumstances and timing remain limited.

The injuries add to a mounting toll of civilian casualties in Gaza. No further details were provided about the condition of the wounded or the exact locations where the shootings took place.

title: Israeli forces wound woman and two children in Gaza
